About

A little about me.

Research Scientist · Optimisation & Algorithms · AI & Machine Learning

Hello, I'm Peace.

I hold a PhD in Computing Science from the University of Glasgow, where my research focused on stable matching problems, their mathematical structures and algorithms.

My interests include combinatorial optimisation, graph algorithms and computational complexity, alongside artificial intelligence and machine learning. I enjoy exploring challenging problems and developing methods to solve them.
